title.en: Tale 5 — The Monkey and the Carpenter

sentences.ar: كليلة قال: خليني أحكي لك قصة.
sentences.en: Kalila said: let me tell you a story.

sentences.ar: قرد شاف نجار بيشق خشبة طويلة.
sentences.en: A monkey watched a carpenter splitting a long plank.
The carpenter would put a wedge in the split.

sentences.ar: راح النجار ياكل، والقرد قعد مكانه.
sentences.en: The carpenter went to eat, and the monkey sat in his place.

sentences.ar: القرد شد الإسفين قبل ما يفهم شغله.
sentences.en: The monkey pulled the wedge before he understood the work.
The plank closed on his hands and hurt him.

sentences.ar: اللي بيتدخل بشغل مش شغله بيتأذى.
sentences.en: Whoever meddles in work that is not his gets hurt.
